# achu

> achu is a free, open-source desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux that beautifies screenshots, stores them in a local gallery, redacts secrets on-device, extracts text via OCR, drafts GitHub bug reports with AI, and exports Code Studio / multi-platform burst packs - all without uploading your images unless you choose to.

achu (அச்சு) means "print" or "mold" in Tamil. Official site: https://achu.app

## What achu does

achu turns raw screenshots into polished, share-ready visuals. It runs locally as an Electron desktop application. Your captures stay on your machine unless you explicitly export, copy, or push a GitHub issue.

## Key features

- Canvas beautification: padding, rounded corners, shadows, mesh gradients, browser chrome mockups, aspect-ratio presets
- Local Screenshot Gallery: save beautified PNG/JPEG/WebP (default `~/achu-screenshots`), browse thumbnails, reopen in editor, soft-delete to `.achu-trash` (30-day auto-purge)
- Smart Privacy Guard: on-device OCR scans for API keys, passwords, emails, IPs; one-click blur or solid redaction
- AI Issue Agent: vision models draft structured GitHub issues; Ollama (local), Gemini, OpenAI, Claude
- OCR text grabber: right-click canvas to extract and copy text via Tesseract WASM (local)
- Code Studio: paste code into beautiful syntax-highlighted share cards (themes, line numbers, language pill, debug points)
- Platform Burst Packs: export one edit to OG / X / LinkedIn / Product Hunt / story sizes with a launch checklist
- Share loop: platform captions with achu.app, optional brand watermark ("Made with achu · achu.app"), Before/After dual-panel export
- Rich annotations: shapes, arrows, text, pen, emoji; undo/redo

## Platforms and pricing

- Platforms: Windows, macOS, Linux
- Price: Free (MIT License)
- Download: https://github.com/QAInsights/achu/releases

| Beautify / frame | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Local privacy redact + OCR | Yes | Yes | Yes | Partial |
| AI GitHub issue drafts | Yes | No | No | No |
| Code Studio | Yes | No | No | No |
| Burst packs (social sizes) | Yes | No | No | Partial |
| Scrolling capture | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Screen recording / GIF | No | Yes | Limited | No |

Full matrix on the site: https://achu.app/#compare

## Frequently asked questions

### What is achu?
achu is a lightweight screenshot beautifier and workflow tool for developers and QA teams. It frames screenshots, annotates them, stores them in a local gallery, redacts sensitive data, beautifies code cards, and can generate GitHub bug reports from images.

### How do I install achu?
Download from https://achu.app or GitHub Releases. Windows portable EXE may show SmartScreen (More info → Run anyway). macOS DMG may need System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway until notarization ships. Linux: AppImage (`chmod +x`) or `.deb`. Walkthrough: https://achu.app/#install

### Does achu upload my screenshots to the cloud?
No. Beautification, gallery storage, privacy scanning, and OCR run locally. External APIs are only used if you configure the AI Issue Agent with a cloud provider - and only for content you approve.

### What is the achu screenshot gallery?
A built-in local library. Save from the footer Gallery button, open via the toolbar grid icon, browse thumbnails, double-click to reopen in the editor. Files live on disk in a folder you choose (default `~/achu-screenshots`).

### What happens when I delete an image from the gallery?
Soft-delete: files move to `.achu-trash` inside your gallery directory and are removed after 30 days.

### Which AI providers does achu support?
Ollama (fully local), Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic Claude for the Issue Agent vision workflow.

### Is achu open source?
Yes. MIT License. Source: https://github.com/QAInsights/achu

### How does achu compare to CleanShot, Shottr, or Xnapper?
achu is free, open source, and cross-platform. Strengths: beautify/frame, local privacy redact + OCR, Code Studio, AI GitHub issues, local gallery, platform burst packs, share captions + brand badge. Trade-offs: no scrolling capture or screen recording yet (areas where CleanShot/Shottr are stronger). Matrix: https://achu.app/#compare

### Does achu put a watermark on exports?
By default new installs show a subtle "Made with achu · achu.app" badge to help discovery. It is one-click off in Extras or Settings, and the preference is saved.
